parrafo_1.es: Maynard's Nuisance Wildlife & Bee Removal es un negocio local de Cape Coral llevado por Nick y su equipo. Las reseñas repiten los mismos nombres, Nick y Jim, llegando rápido cuando aparece un enjambre de abejas, una iguana o un mapache donde no debería estar.
parrafo_1.en: Maynard's Nuisance Wildlife & Bee Removal is a local Cape Coral business run by Nick and his crew. The reviews keep naming the same two people, Nick and Jim, showing up fast whenever a bee swarm, an iguana or a raccoon turns up somewhere it should not be.

parrafo_2.es: El equipo trabaja con trampeo humanitario para mapaches, zarigüeyas e iguanas, y retira colmenas de abejas vivas de árboles y estructuras sin necesidad de exterminarlas, atendiendo Cape Coral las 24 horas.
parrafo_2.en: The team uses humane trapping for raccoons, opossums and iguanas, and relocates live bee colonies out of trees and structures instead of exterminating them, serving Cape Coral around the clock.

texto.es: Abejas, iguanas, mapaches o zarigüeyas: cuéntale al equipo qué tienes y dónde está.
texto.en: Bees, iguanas, raccoons or opossums: tell the crew what you have and where it is.

texto.es: Nick y su equipo llegan a revisar el problema y a decidir el método correcto para cada caso.
texto.en: Nick and the crew come out to look at the problem and decide the right method for the job.

texto.es: Trampeo sin dañar al animal, o retiro de la colmena de abejas viva, según lo que haya que resolver.
texto.en: Humane trapping that does not harm the animal, or live removal of the bee hive, depending on the job.

texto.es: Los clientes reportan resultados desde la primera noche de servicio.
texto.en: Customers report results from the very first night of service.

nota.es: Cada trabajo se cotiza según el animal y el lugar. Llama al (239) 245-0176 para un presupuesto.
nota.en: Every job is quoted based on the animal and the location. Call (239) 245-0176 for a price.

texto.es: Enjambres y colmenas retirados de árboles y estructuras, reubicando las abejas en vez de exterminarlas.
texto.en: Swarms and hives removed from trees and structures, relocating the bees instead of killing them.

texto.es: Captura de iguanas que invaden patios, muros y propiedades frente al agua en Cape Coral.
texto.en: Trapping iguanas that take over yards, seawalls and waterfront properties around Cape Coral.

tag.es: En el ático o el patio

texto.es: Trampeo de animales metidos en el ático, debajo de la casa o en el patio, con resultados rápidos.
texto.en: Trapping animals stuck in the attic, under the house or in the yard, with results fast.

texto.es: Un enjambre de abejas o un animal atrapado no esperan: el equipo atiende llamadas fuera de horario.
texto.en: A bee swarm or a trapped animal does not wait: the crew takes after-hours calls.

pie.es: ¿Tienes otro animal metido donde no debería? Llama igual: si es fauna local, probablemente lo resuelven.
pie.en: Got a different critter somewhere it should not be? Call anyway: if it is local wildlife, they probably handle it.

items.quote: I highly recommend Nick! We had a bee infestation under our shed and he and Jimmy came out the very next day and removed it for us. They were the best! Also removed a small snake for us that showed up while they were here.

Excellent service at a reasonable cost. We had a significant problem with an iguana infestation. Maynard's went above and beyond to make sure our problem was addressed. They were knowledgeable about how to address the problem.

Twice I had to utilize pest removal for animals in my attic. The first company had 0 results for a weeks worth of service. Second go round I used Maynard's. Nick and Jim were amazing. Results the first night.
